summary: Bing Image Creator is free for everyone with a personal Microsoft account, offering image generation with Microsoft MAI-Image, GPT-Image, and DALL-E-class models. You get 15 fast creations per day plus slower standard-speed generations (up to 200 prompts per 24 hours).
claim_steps: Visit bing.com/create or the Bing Image Creator feature page.
Sign in with a personal Microsoft account (work/school Entra accounts are not supported).
Enter a prompt and press Create; each generation uses one of your daily creations.
Return daily - the 15 fast creations replenish every day.
